title: [Workspaces] Migrate Editor from WPF to WinUI 3

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Exact-head Settings source confirms the diagnostics-viewer setting converts ETL files from the PowerToys ETW directory and opens that directory. This strengthens the user-visible consumer evidence for the existing private lifecycle hypothesis, but event-emission counterevidence and unverified runtime behavior remain explicit. The next gate is an isolated, serialized comparison of process-matched editor ETL output with both relevant settings enabled versus recording disabled, followed by candidate validation only if the enabled case confirms the gap. No build, test or runtime comparison ran; the finding remains private and review remains in progress.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
